name: Among the Others
summary: Among the Others is a parody ROM hack of Sonic the Hedgehog for the Sega Genesis. This project is known for its bizarre, glitchy atmosphere and its unique character system: by default, players can play as Sonic with advanced moves like a double jump and air dash, but pressing B at the title screen activates a "soul" mode where you play as a Pepsi can.
